texto: Make line-based edits to a text file. Edits apply in order, each to the result of the ones before it, and each replaces the first match of its oldText with newText. oldText must match the file's text exactly, except that line endings (LF or CRLF) never matter and, when there is no exact match, a run of whole lines matches if each line is equal once leading and trailing whitespace is ignored (newText then takes the file's indentation). Whitespace inside a line must match. If any edit has no match, nothing is written and the error shows the closest lines of the file, numbered, to copy oldText from. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made. Only works within allowed directories.
